segments.en:
And the first rectification found equally in all Partzufim is the division of its lights into 613d — for so below in the lower human being there are found 613 limbs35 — and in the Torah: 613 commandments. I have already explained in the First Principles36 that this number was measured out by the supernal willf — and upon it Creation stands in the conditiong that it is today.

And after this rectification there follow other rectifications — such as for example: the extension37 of the parts of the face, the mouth, the fingers of the hands and the feet. The Sefiros of the face are from the extension of Chochmah.38 [In the printed version: And the order of their extension is this: the two eyes are ChV"B; the forehead — Da'as; the two temples are ChV"G; the top of the nose — Tiferes; the two ears — N"H; the end of the nose — Yesod; the nostrils — Malchus.] And the Sefiros of the mouth are from the extension of Binah. [In the printed version: And the order of their extension is: the palate and throat — ChV"B; the two gums — ChV"G; the two lips — N"H; the tongue is the intermediate one39 — which is Da'as, Tiferes, Yesod; and the mouth40 — Malchus.] The fingers of the hands are the extension of the Chasadim and Gevuros into five. And they are also the general Sefiros of the higher Partzuf from which the lower one emerges — and the fingers of the feet are the root of the lower Partzuf that emerges from the upper.41 These matters will be further explained in their proper places, with G-d's help. And now we shall explain the particular rectifications — each in its place.42

segments.he:
בסימן ט״ז ,וביאור הענץ ע׳׳ש סי׳ ל״ג בסופו .בראשונה היו כולם בחינות נפשות, ביאור ענק זה מדוע יצא מתחלה בבחינת נפש בסוף סימן ל׳׳ה .וזהו עקודים ,כבר כתבתי ענץ עולם העקודים כנ״ל ,ובסי׳ מ״ט הנ״ל מבואר שכל אלה הכנות עי׳׳ש בביאור הענץ ,ובסס״י ל׳׳ה ,ובסי׳ ל״ג ובפחו״ד דף כ״ג כ״ד כ׳׳ה. פ ״ב (מ׳׳א) ופירש שם מסך מבדיל ,לשק הגר״א ז׳׳ל בפי׳ ספרא דצניעותא דף ג׳ ע׳׳ג :וזהו עיקר התיקון להתמעט האור שיוכלו התחתונים לקבל האור וכו׳ ,ולכן בהתחלת התיקון פרם חד פרסה להעלים האור למעלה עכ״ל ,וע׳ זאת בביאור יותר שם דף מ׳׳ב ע׳׳א .ומן חב׳׳ן יצאו מהעינים כו׳ ,בכלל ענק עולם הנקודים מבואר בפתחי חכמה מן סימן ל״ו והלאה כי על זה בנדם כל דבריו שם< ,וא״צ לרשום בפרטות), והטעם שיצאו מן אוזן חוטם פה קודם העינים ,וכן מן העינים קודם של המצח ,מבואר בפתחי חכמה סימן ל״ד ,וכן הטעם מדוע מן ע׳׳ב יצאו כולם רק הם נעלמים ושל ס׳׳ג יצאו רק חלקים וכו׳ ,מבואר שם בסימן ל״ה חלק ב׳ .נמצאו ראשונות מתוקנות זה כנגד זה והשאר זה תחת זה ,ביאורו בפ׳׳ח סימן נ״ב. (מ׳׳ב) יצאו עשרה כלים וכו׳ ,בכלל מדובר בזה ברוב הספר פתחי חכמה ובפרט מן סימן ל״ו והלאה ולא שייך לרשום בפרט( ,מ״מ ארשום קצת אמה דברים בפרט) ,ושם נתבאר ענק השבירה והירידה והתיקון ,וכלים ואורות הכל באר היטב .ירדו האורות, טעם ירידת האורות מתחלה אע׳׳ג שהוצרכו אח״כ לחזור ,שם סימן נ׳ .נשברו דרדו, הוא שני בחינות כדלקמן ,וענק פי׳ שבירה בפרט שם בסימן נ״ד( ,דרידה יורשם לקמן) .ואורותיהם עלו למקומם ,ביאור זה שם בסימן מ״א .ועליהם הוא אומר ואלה המלכים כו׳ ,מבואר באורך בביאור הגר״א ז״ל על ספרא דצניעותא פ׳׳א דף י׳׳ב ע ״ג ובדף ט׳׳ו באורך. (מ״ג) ומהם נעשה ד׳ עולמות אבי׳׳ע ,ביאורו בסי׳ ל״ח ,ובסי׳ מ׳ ,וביאור ד׳ עולמות אבי׳׳ע יעדק עוד בנפשה׳׳ח(ש׳׳א פי׳׳ג בהג״ה) ובם׳ חוקר ומקובל בפרקים האחרונים פ׳׳י .ומסופם יוצא הרע ,באורו בפתחי חכמה ,סי׳ מ״ג מ״ד מ׳׳ה מ׳׳ט ,ומה שאמר מסופם ביאורו שם סי׳ מ׳׳ז ,וביאור ענק הס״א באורך שם בסימן ל׳ יעו׳׳ש .אין בהם חיבור כו׳ ונרגן מפריד כו׳ יתפרדו כו׳ ,ביאור זה שם בסי׳ נ׳׳ב באורך .אבל בקדושים כו׳ שתיקץ הכל באחדות ,ביאורו שם בסימן נ׳׳ב. (מ״ד) נשברו ונפלו ,פי׳ לשק שבירה שם בסימן נ׳׳ד ,ופי׳ ענק הנפילה ,ביארו שם בסימן מ׳׳ו .דרד הטוב שבהם לבריאה כו׳ ,ביאור זה שם סימן ל״ח מ׳ מ״ו ,ובסימן מ׳׳ז .נגנז האור שנברא ביום א׳ ,היינו האצילות הראשק הכללי וביאורו בסימן מ׳׳א, ובפרט בסימן מ׳׳ו ושם בסי׳ מ׳׳ז .אך האצילות הא׳ לא חזר וכו׳ .ונעשה מג׳ ד׳ כו׳, ביאורו שם בסימן מ״ט .ומסופה הרע יוצא ,כבר נתבאר ,והוא מבואר שם בסימן מ׳׳ט, ובסימן מ׳׳ז ,וענק הס״א בסימן ל׳. (מ״ה) ז׳׳ת ירדו לבריאה כו׳ ,כבר נתבאר ,ושם מבואר בסי׳ נ״א .ואחוריהם של או׳׳א וכו׳ ונה״י של כתר כו׳ ,מבואר יפה בפתחי חכמה סי׳ נ׳׳א ,ובסי׳ נ״ג. (מ״ו) כיצד נפלו כו /ענק הנפילה כבר נרשם וכנ׳׳ל ,וענק ירידתה לבריאה ג״כ נרשם למעלה. (מ׳׳ח) ורפ׳׳ח נצוצק של אודות כו׳ ,ביאורו בפתחי חכמה סי׳ נ״ז .ובסי׳ נ׳׳ה .מד׳ ע״ב דע״ב כו׳ ,סי׳ ד׳ מיני שמות של מספר ע׳׳ב ,ומכל אחד <של ע׳׳ב ס׳׳ג מ״ה ב״ן) נדרש מספר ע׳׳ב באופן אחר ,וביאור דבר זה באורך ,בפ״ח בסימן נ׳׳ה ובסימן נ״ו ,והטעם מה שחושב לב׳׳ן מספר ריבוע והרי הוא בכל השמות ,ביאורו שם סי׳ נ״ו .ובסופן של

מראת מקומות

דברים מהו אומר כו׳ רפואה שאץ אחריה מכה כו׳ והיה למלך כ ר ,מבואר במקומות הרבה שם( ,ונרשם למעלה פ״א מ״א) ,ועוד מבואר שם סימן ל״ז ל״ט מ״ב מ״ח מ״ט, ובכל הספר בכמה מקומות ועוד שם בסי׳ ל׳ באורך. פ׳׳ג (מ׳׳א) מן המצח ,ענץ זה הוא מובאר בפ׳׳ח סימן ל״ב באורך ,ובסימן נ״ט ם׳. חמשה כד ועתיק כד ,יתבאר בע״ה לקמן על כל אחד במקומו .וענץ פרצוף ,שם סי׳ י״ז ע׳ ע״א .כתר דמ׳׳ה וכו׳ דב״׳ן כד ,פי׳ ענץ חיבורים הללו והטעם להם בפ״ח סימן ס״א ס״ב ועוד מדובר באורך בענץ חיבור מ״ה וב״ן שם מסימן פ׳ עד סימן פ״ט באורך ,ובסימן צ״ח צ״ט ,תיקונם בזו׳׳ן ,ביאורו שם בסימן ס״ג מבואר שם יפה ,ועוד סימן ס״ד ס״ה ס״ו ,ובסימן ע״ב ע״ג ,ובזו״ן הס נתקנים בזווג ,עיבור ,ולידה ,ביאר זה בפרטות שם סימן ס״ו ,ועוד בסי׳ ע״ב ,ועוד שם מבואר באורך בסימן ק״כ קכ״א קכ״ב ,וגדלות ,שם בסימן ק״כ קכ״א ,וענץ הגדלות בפרטות יורשם לקמן בע״ה ית״ש, ענץ עיבוד ,ע׳ בפי׳ הגד״א ז״ל על ס״ד דף י״ט ע״א שורה ג׳ ,ועברו בהם דיך מעבר וכו׳ ה״ס העיבור כו׳ ע״ש. (מ״ב) בזווג כיצד כו׳ ,שם בסימן ס״ד ביאר זה .ובסימן ס״ו ,ובסימן ע״ב, ובסימן ק״כ קכ״א קכ״ב ,ובהג״ה שבר״ס נפש החיים ז׳ ע״ב כתב שם בזה״ל זווגים הוא מודעת שהוא רק משל על חיבור ענינים רוחנים כענץ אדם המחבר תחלה בשכלו ב׳ סברות בשכל ומחבור ב׳ הסברות נולד לו סברא חדשה עפ׳׳י הקדמות שני הסברות הראשונות עכ״ל ע״ש וע׳ פ״ח סי׳ ע״ג .מעלה גוק׳ בירורים כו׳ ,ביאור זה בפתחי חכמה סימן ס״ד .יצאו למקומם זהו לידה ,בפתחי חכמה שם סי׳ קכ״א קכ״ב .והגיע לשיעורו כו׳ יונק מתחלה כו׳ השלים והלביש כו׳ ,שם במקומות הנ״ל ,ובפרט בסי׳ קכ״א. (מ״ד) עתיק ,ענץ עתיק בפרטות מבואר בפתחי חכמה מן סימן ע״ד עד סימן ע״ח ,ומן סימן פ״ה עד סימן צ׳ ,ובסימן צ״ח צ״ט ,ובסימן צ״ו צ״ז ,והוא נקרא ג״כ רישא דלא אתיידע כנודע .דו׳׳ג זכר מלפניו כו׳ נמצא עתיק כולו פנים ,מבואר שם בסימן ע״ה ע״ו ע״ז ,ובסי׳ ע״ג .נתקן אריך כד ,ענץ ארך אנפץ ,באורך שם מן סימן צ׳ עד סימן צ״ז, ומן סימן צ׳׳ט עד סי׳ ק״ה(ובסימן ע׳׳ג מבואר ענץ חיבור דד׳׳נ שלו) .נתקן אריך ו ת הזכר בימינו כד ,מבואר בסימן ע״ה (בביאור שם) ,ובסימן ע״ג מבואר מזה ג״כ. תיקונו של א׳׳א מזווגו של עתיק כד ,כבד נרשם ענץ זה ,והוא מבואר בסי׳ ע״ז ,ובסי׳ ס׳ מבואר ג״כ מזה. (מ׳׳ה) או״א זה זכר וזה נקבה ,ענץ אבא ואימא מבואר שם באורך מן סימן קי״א עד סי׳ קט״ו ,ובסימן קכ״ח קכ״ט ,ומזווגם כד ,ענץ זווג או״א שם בסימן קי״ב קי״ג. יסודו של עתיק כלה בחזהו כד ,ביאור ענץ זה בפ׳׳ח שם סימן ק״י ,ועוד שם בסימן ח׳ מזה .וישראל סבא כד ותבונה ,ענץ התחלקות או״א לשנים ,אבא וי״ס ,אימא ותבונה, מבואר שם בסימן קי״ג קכ״ח קכ״ט ,ושם מבואר ענץ ישראל סבא ,ותבונה ג״כ. (מ״ו) מלבישים כד ,ענץ ההלבשה בכלל ,בסי׳ יו״ד ,ובסימן ק׳ מבואר טעם כללי לחילוקי ההתלבשות שאינם שדם ,וע״ש בביאורם. (מ״ח) ישסו׳׳ת כיצד מלכותם כד ,ביאור זה שם בסימן קכ״ח קכ״ט .אבא ד״ס כד פעמים שנים פעמים א׳ כד ,מבואר יפה שם בסי׳ קכ״ח ,קכ״ט. (מ״ט) מוחץ של ז״א כד ,הוא מבואר שם בסימן קי״ב קי״ג ,ובפרטות יותר בסימן קט״ז קי״ז קכ״ד קכ״ז קכ״ח קכ״ט .זהו הצלם ,ביאור ענץ זה שם קכ״ז קכ׳׳ח קכ״ט, וענץ הצלם מבואר עוד באורך בהגהה שבראש ס׳ נפש החיים .כיצד מלכותו של עליון כד ,כל ענץ משנה זו מבואר שם בסימן קכ״ז קכ״ח קכ״ט.

segments.en: The first is the rectification of the three heads. This is its matter: the Keser of A"A is the first head.42* And Chochmah — which is the brain — is the third head. And the air that is between the Keser and the Chochmah — there the Da'as of Atik is located43 — and it is the second head. In these three heads there are inner dimension and outer dimension — as in all other lights. And each one44 of them has three aspects: inner; surrounding; surrounding of the surrounding. And in them45 are found the two Names: YHVH and Ehyeh — YHVH in the inner dimension, and Ehyeh in the outer dimension. Except that in the first head they are full of Yuds;46 in the second — Yuds and Alefs;47 in the third — with Alefs.48 And all the Names are vowel-pointed. And according to what we said — that in each head there are three aspects — three YHVH will be found in each head, and likewise three Ehyeh — but the difference is in their vowel-pointing.49

(מ׳׳ח) עתיק ,נרשם למעלה פ״ג מ׳׳ד .מלכות של א״ק שנעשה עתיק באצילות ,ביאור זה בפ׳׳ח סימן ם׳ ובסימן ע׳׳ד ובסימן צ״ז מבואר ג״כ מזה ע״ש ,ובסימן צ׳׳ו .עתיק זו׳׳ג זכר בפניו כו׳ ,ענין זה מבואר שם בסי׳ ע״ג ע׳׳ה ע׳׳ו ע״ז .תחתונות שבה מתלבשים באצילות חסד בכתר וכו׳ ,ביאור זה בסי׳ צ״ו ובסי׳ צ״ט ובסימן ק׳ באורך, ובסימן ק׳׳ב ,ועוד מבואר מזה מה שבמקום אחר נאמר שיסוד דעתיק כלה ביסוד דא׳׳א ביאור כ׳׳ז בסי׳ ק׳׳י קי׳׳א ובסי׳ ח׳ ,וסדר ההתלבשות והתחלקות של עתיק (שהוא רדל׳׳א) בא׳׳א מבואר באורך בביאור הגר״א ז׳׳ל על ספרא דצניעותא פ״א דף ט׳ י׳. פ׳׳ ח(מ׳׳א) תלת רישץ בעתיקא כו׳ ב׳ נעשים ג׳ ,ביאור ענץ זה מה שנדרש לפעמים שנחלק א״א לשני רישין ,גלגלת ומוחא ולפעמים לתלת רישץ ,גלגלתא אוירא ומוחא, וכן בשני האדרות מדובר בשני אופנים הנ״ל ,מבואר כל זה באורך בפתחי חכמה סימן צ״ה ק״א ק׳׳ב ,ועוד שם בסימן ק״ד( ,ביאור ג׳ הרישין) .דעתו של עתיק באוירא, ביאור זה שם בסימן צ״ט .באלו מתנהגים כו׳ בחסד וכדין וברחמים ,היינו זהו ענץ תלת רישץ חד״ר ,ומבואר שם צ״ה ,ובפרטות יותר בסימן ק״ד. (מ׳׳ב) פנימיות כו׳ חיצוניותן כו׳ ,ענק פנימית וחיצונית נרשם למעלה פ״א מ״ב .מקיף כי׳ ,ענין פנימית וחיצוניות ,וענין מקיף החוזר ומקיף הישר וב׳ מיני מקיפים כל זה מבואר באורך בסי׳ כ״ח כ״ט .בניקודיהם ,ענין אותיות ונקודות בפ״ח סימן י״ט כ״א כ״ב ,וענץ שם הוי״ה בסי׳ ל״א. (מ״ג) שבעה כו׳ בגלגלתא כד ,ביאור מזה בפ״ח סימן ק״ב יעו״ש .רעוא דמצחא כו׳, מבואר שם בסימן ק״ג ,והתחלקות הז׳ תיקונים הללו וביאורם בביאור הגר׳׳א ז״ל על ס״ד פ״א דף ח׳ ט׳ יו״ד י׳׳א. (מ״ד) י״ג חיורתי כד ,ביאור ענץ החיורתא ותוכן ענינם בביאור הגר״א ז״ל על ס״ד פ״א דף י״ח י״ט כ׳ ע׳׳ש .דיקנא כו׳ י׳׳ג תיקוני דיקנא כד ,ענץ הדיקנא מבואר בפ״ח סי׳ ק״ה ק״ו ק״ז ק״ח קי״א( ,וע״ל משנה ה׳) ,ועוד ענץ הי״ג תיקוני דיקנא שם בסימן ל״ב ח״א. (מ״ה)(דיקנא ,נרשם למעלה משנה ד׳) ,ועוד ענין המזלות נוצר ונקה שם בסימן קי״א קי״ד ,וענין הי״ג שנזכר למעלה במשנה ד׳ ,וכאן ביאר בביאור הגר״א ז״ל על ספרא דצניעותא כי ענין התלת רישין המה כנגד השלשה דרכים חסד רץ ורחמים (וכמ״ש בפ״ח ג״כ בסימן צ״ה ובסימן ק״ד וש״מ) ובכל אחד מהתלת רישין ג״כ יש בו שלשה הנ״ל חד״ר ,וכל אחד מן חר״ר הנ״ל המה הוי״ה שלמה שהם ד׳ [שהם חד״ר והמקבל כמ״ש בפתחי חכמה שם בסימן ק״ד] ,וא׳ הכוללם הרי י״ג ,וע״ש שכתב מעין זה. segments.en: And now I shall explain to you what these three heads are. You must know: even though we said there are three YHVHs52 — the truth is that afterward there is one YHVH that encompasses all of them together53 — and the secret of the matter is that the order of governance is thus54 — and it was connected from the very beginning of the world55 — which is A"A. And the order is Chesed-Din-Rachamim — three distinct governances. And afterward Malchus is the secret of the totality — which distributes to the lower beings with the agreement of the governances.56 And the root of the three governances is in these three heads. And they extend one after the other57 — from there to Av"A and Da'as — which is the Mazal that is between them58 — and from there to the Mochin of Z"A. And all of this is the secret of the male who influences. And afterward the female emerges59 — which is the receiver; but she too is rooted in these heads — for in each head there are also these three YHVHs, and also the one that encompasses — in the secret of Malchus as above.60 And the secret of this is Reisha d'Lo Isyada61 — for the worlds always emerge from one another like this. Reisha d'Lo Isyada is the general root of the Malchus of Atzilus62 — and the nine Sefiros of A"A are from above it.63 For the governance is given to Malchus — and the higher ones stand to give it power.64 And the beginning of this matter is from the Tzimtzum and the extension of the line.65 And I shall explain more of this, with G-d's help, in the matter of the surrounding.

segments.en:
From the hidden Chochmah many channels emerge — and they pierce the skull and emerge outside — and encompass over the head — and also extend downward to the place delineated for them. And these are called the hairs. And their action: to draw the light of the Chochmah itself79 — bounded and concealed within them — to the place they need to bring it; for at their ends it emerges.80 Now since the governance divides into Chesed-Din-Rachamim and the totality — as I explained — it also divides into the secret of thirteen — for three YHVHs have twelve letters81 — and the encompassing YHVH is thirteen. Therefore these hairs also divide into thirteen locks — and are called the thirteen nimin (threads) of the hairs. And these hairs are Dins — for they are made to conceal the radiance and limit it. And they emerge from the power of the Gevurah of Atik clothed in this Chochmah.

The second rectifications are the seven rectifications of the head — and they come from the radiance of the seven lower Sefiros of Atik that clothe themselves within A"A. And in his head they make these seven rectifications — which are: G"T K"R"A P"Ch.68

מ. כללי חכמת האמת הם קיצור של השתלשלות העולמות והפרצופים מראשית הצמצום ,ומגיעים עד פרצופי או״א .כנראה נתחברו על ידי אחד מגדולי תלמידי רמח״ל ,הלא הוא רבי ישראל חזקיהו טריויס זצ״ל . ,הספר כולו ספוג מתורתו של רמח״ל .הוא משלב בתוך החיבור כמה קטעים שהעתיק מכתבי רבנו. החיבור היה גם למראה עיני רמח״ל ,והוא הוסיף בכמה מקומות הערות והוספות ותיקונים בין השורות ובגליון בכתב ידו .הספר בנוי כדרך כללות האיל[ הק׳ ופתחי חכמה ודעת — לתת לנו תיאור תמציתי מהשתלשלות האילן הק׳. כדי שהלומד לא יתקשה בהתחלת לימודו בסוגיות העמוקות ,לכן אלה הפרקים שיש בהם סוגיות עמוקות ,וכן פרקים שיש בהם פרטים ,ופרטי פרטים ,שאינם נחוצים לתפיסה הכללית של בנין העולמות והפרצופים, נדפסו באותיות קטנות יותר ,כדי שיהיה ניכר לעיני הלומד על מה לדלג בתחילת לימודו .קטעים אלה אינם פחות חשובים כשלעצמם מיתר החלקים ,הרי יש ביניהם פרקים שהמעתיק כותב שהעתיקם מכתב יד רבו רמח״ל .אלא כאמור ,אינם נחוצים לתפיסה הכללית של מבנה האילן הקדוש ,לכן בתחילת לימודו ידלג עליהם הלומד ,ואחרי שגמר ושנה את החיבור ,ילמד גם את הפרקים האלה. כתב היד נפסק בסוף דרושי אבא ואימא .אפשר להשלים את לימוד פרצופי זעיר־אנפין ונוקבא וכו׳ בספר פתחי חכמה ודעת מפרק נו עד פרק עח. כללי חכמת האמת הם קיצור ותמצית מהספר עץ חיים ,כמו ספר פתחי חכמה ודעת .אולם הבדל יש ביניהם בדרכי ההסברה ,כי בפתחי חכמה ודעת שילב רבנו ביאורים ותירוצים לקושיות על דברי האריז״ל, 2 . 1כך נראה מתוך השואת כתב היד לשאר כתיבות של ר״י טריוים .עי׳ בספר ״כתבי הקבלה של הרמח׳׳ל׳׳ עמ׳ . 128 . 2עי׳ בהקדמה לפתחי חכמה ודעת.

שערי רמח"ל

כללות האילן הקדוש
segments.en:
The first rectification is the whiteness of the skull — being a great and powerful Chesed,69 and this flows from the Chesed of Atik that is clothed in it.70

And between the hairs are found the Chivurta — the part of the head revealed between the hairs. And I have already heard81 that this skull is white from the light of the Chesed of Atik clothed in it.82 And these radiations too will extend into thirteen — in the secret of the governance mentioned — this being through the three YHVHs and the encompassing one — in the Avira83 — which is the second head — and the three YHVHs and the encompassing one — in the Kitra — which is the first head.

מד. עשרה פרקים בסדר ועניין האילן הקדוש

הקדמת לכללי חכמת האמת

רבנו אמנם אינו מזכיר את הקושיות ,כדרכו בקודש ,כפי שכותב :״ואני לא רשמתי הקושיות והתירוצים ,אלא הנחתי ההקדמות ,אשר תפולנה על ידיהם הקושיות ממילא״ . 3דרך זו עלולה להקשות על הלומד בראשית לימודו את הבנת הדברים ,כי עדיין אינו מבין את מה שרבנו טורח להסביר. לכן יותר קל הוא להתחיל ללמוד את השתלשלות העולמות והפרצופים עד סוף או״א בחיבור כללי חכמת האמת ,וכאמור להשלים את פרצופי ז״א ונוקבא וכו׳ בספר פתחי חכמה ודעת ,ואחר כך לחזור על השתלשלות העולמות והפרצופים מתחילתם עד סופם — בספר פתחי חכמה ודעת. כללי חכמת האמת נדפסו לראשונה על ידי ר׳ שמואל לוריא זצ״ל בוורשא שנת תרמד ,וברוב ההוצאות מופיעות יחד עם פתחי חכמה ודעת. בס״ד הגהנו את החיבור מתוך כתב יד ירושלים (' ‘ .)8 — 5217 חלקנו את החיבור לפרקים וקטעים ,ונתנו כותרות לפרקים ,והוספנו פיסוק ,כדי שהלומד יוכל להפיק את מירב התועלת מחיבור חשוב זה בעזהשי״ת. .3ספר רמח״ל ובני דורו מכתב נ! בספר ירים משה הוא מכתב לט.
segments.en:
The second rectification is Gazla d'Vedulcha71 — a rectification found in the hidden Chochmah — from the clothing of the Gevurah of Atik within it. And it is found to encompass Chesed and Din together — for of itself it is Chesed because of the right column in which it stands72 — but from the side of the Gevurah of Atik it is also a root for the Gevuros. And therefore it is found standing in the governance of the third head — which stands for the governance of Din.73

§14 — The Thirteen Rectifications of the Dikna [Klalus HaIlan 8:5]

מז. הקדמה

א) תכלית הבריאה

ידוע הדבר למפורש הוא ,כי תחלת המחשבה סוף המעשה .נמצא שתכלית השי״ת בבריאת העולם היה בעבור האדם ,היינו ישראל שקרואים אדם ,וזה כדי שיקבלו התורה והמצוות ,ועל ידם יזכו לחיי העוה׳׳ב .וכדי שיקבלו שכר על עשייתן ברא בהם היצה״ר המונע מלעשותן .ובהתגברם עליו — מקבלים שכר .וכן להפך ,מי שאינו מתגבר על יצרו — נענש .ואם לא היה יצה״ר בעולם ,אלא האדם היה כטבעו להיות צדיק או רשע — לא היד .לא שכד ולא עונש .וכיון שבריאת היצה״ר באדם היא מוכרחת כמ״ש ,לכן הוצרך גם כן שגוף האדם יהיה נברא מהחומר היותר עב ,עד שיוכל היצר לשלוט בו .שאם האדם היה נברא מחומר דק ורוחני ,אז לא היה יכול היצר לשלוט בו, ונמצאת בריאתו לריק.
segments.en:
The third rectification: Keroma d'Avira — a membrane like one thin membrane that stands around the hidden Chochmah to cover it. And it flows from the radiance of the Tiferes of Atik in this head74 — and its action is to seal against the light of the skull75 — so it does not illuminate further within Chochmah — and to close the light of Chochmah so it does not descend too greatly to the lower ones.

And other hairs emerge toward the face — and encompass over them — and extend downward similarly — and their division into thirteen is in the secret of the above84 — and they are called the thirteen rectifications of the Dikna (beard). And the truth is: the other rectifications are radiations needed for the preparation of the influence and the attainment — but the governance itself is in the Dikna — for through it the abundance passes. Therefore I shall explain it well.

נ. כ) צמצוס

וכדי לברוא זאת הבריאה שזכרנו ,עלה ברצון המאציל העליון אץ סוף ב״ה ,עילת כל העילות ,סיבת כל הסיבות ,לצמצם אודו ,שהיה מתפשט בכל העולמות ,ולתת מקום שיוכלו התחתונים לעמוד .שאם לא היה זה ,היו העולמות מתבטלים ברוב האור .כי הלא כל מציאות העולמות אינו אלא עיבוי אחד עיבוי ,ואס האור הזה היה מאיד בכל צד בשוה ,כבר היו כולם שוים ,ולא נראים כלל .והוצרך גם כן ,לשום מסכים בינו לתחתונים ,כדי למעט האור ,שלא ירד כל כך בתוקף ,באופן שיוכלו לקבל אותו .והמסכים הם המדריגות המונעים האוד ,וממעטים אותו ,עד שהולך ומתמעט ומתעבה עיבוי אחר עיבוי ,עד שנברא גוף האדם מהאור היותר עב שיוכל להיות ,מהטעם שאמרנו .ואל תחשוב ח״ו שיהיה שום שינוי במאציל עצמו ,כי חלילה לומר כן .אלא השינוי הוא מהמקבלים כפי התרחקם או התקדבם אליו .דרך משל :נר אחד שיהיה לפני אדם אחד .אם ישימו לפניו כמה מסכים ,עד שלא היה נהנה מהאור אלא מעט ,לא מפני זה יהיה שום שינוי בנר עצמו ,אלא באדם שאינו

The fourth rectification: Raava d'Raavin — one rectification made in the forehead of A"A — in which the Chasadim76 shine — emerging from the Yesod of Atik; and it becomes a willing forehead (metzach ratzon) — when it is revealed, all the Dins are annulled.

The Dikna — meaning the hairs of the face — has thirteen rectifications, as stated; and they are encompassed in two: which are the eighth rectification and the thirteenth rectification. And I shall explain to you the order of the rectifications according to the form of the beard in man.

נד. יכול לראות הנר מחמת המסכים המבדילים .כן הענין כאן ,כי אין שום שינוי במאציל ,אלא במקבלים.

ג) ע ש ר ס פי רו ת

ונתחיל לפרש ענין עשר הספירות ,שהם המסכים שזכרנו למעלה. עשר הספירות הם עשר מדריגות שהאציל המאציל להיותם צינורות, שעל ידם יריק השפע לתחתונים ,ולהגבילו באופן שהעולמות לא יתבטלו ברוב האור ,ויהיה להם העמדה וקיום .ועשאם עשר כלים ,כדי שהשפע בעברו דרך אותם הכלים — יתעבה כל כך עד שיוכלו התחתונים לסבול אותו .ואלו העשר ספירות נקראים :כתר ,חכמה ,בינה, חסד ,גבורה ,תפארת ,נצח ,הוד ,יסוד ,מלכות ,על שם הנהגתם בחסד או בדין או ברחמים ,וכיוצא .והולכים בסדר קוים ,היינו קו ימץ :חכמה חסד נצח — חסד ,קו שמאל :בג״ה — דין ,קו אמצעי :דת״י — רחמים .ואין לך שום אור שהאציל המאציל שאינו כלול מחד״ר .ולא שיצאו אלו האורות כל אחד לבדו אלא יצאו כולם מורכבים מזאת הבחינה שאמרנו .וכל הנהגת העולם בדרך זה .ואלו עשר הספירות נקראים דמות אדם ,היינו כתר :גולגולת ,חכמה בינה :תרץ מוחין ,חסד גבורה :תרץ דרועץ ,תפארת :הגוף ,נצח הוד :תרץ שוקץ ,יסוד :אות ברית ,מלכות :עטרה .וכל אחת מהם נבנית מעשר אורות ,עד אץ תכלית.
segments.en:
The fifth rectification: Amar Naki — these are the hairs of the head — which emerge from the starting points of the NHY of Atik77 — the place where they are above the Yesod. That is to say: from this radiance these lights are made — of which it is said they emerge as channels from the hidden Chochmah in the form of hairs — which are like long hooks — in the secret of N"H — extended to their action.

Rectification 1: The two payos (sidelocks) — on the right and the left. Rectification 2: The hairs of the upper lip. Rectification 3: The path beneath the nose — free of hairs. Rectification 4: The hairs of the lower lip. Rectification 5: The path beneath the mouth corresponding to the one beneath the nose. Rectification 6: The breadth of the beard. Rectification 7: The two cheeks — free of hairs. Rectification 8: The upper surface of the beard that descends reaching the navel — Mazal Notzer. Rectification 9: Short hairs beneath this surface — on the lower surface. Rectification 10: Hairs beneath the throat. Rectification 11: That they are all equal. Rectification 12: The mouth — free of hairs. Rectification 13: The lower surface that descends with the upper one to the navel — Mazal Nakkeh.

נז. ובהאיר באחת מהם אור אחד ,נקראת ספירה .ואם יאירו כל אחת בעשר הארותיה ,נקרא פרצוף .ולהקרא פרצוף שלם — צריך שכל בחינה פרטית שבה תאיר בכל הארותיה ,עד שיעלו האורות למנץ תרי׳׳ג, כמנץ איברים שבאדם ,ואז נקרא שלם .וענין זה יתבאר עוד לפנים בס״ד. והפרצופים אינם כי אם חמשה לבד ,כי לא בל ספירה וספירה היה בה כח להאיר בבחינה זו ,אלא כתר חכמה בינה ומלכות ,והם הנקראים א״א או״א ונוק׳ .אבל הו׳ קצוות לא היה בהם כח להאיר כל אחת מהם באופן זה ,אלא בהקבצם יחד נבנו ונעשו פרצוף אחד ,ונקרא ז׳׳א .וענץ אלו הפרצופים נבאר בס״ד.

And behold, the two surfaces encompass all the others in them — and they are called the two Mazalos85 — and their secret is male and female. For the upper Mazal is the male — encompassing all aspects of the male: the twelve that emerge from the three YHVHs — which are the secret of the male, as stated. And the lower Mazal is the female — emerging from the one86 that encompasses. And all the other rectifications87 produce particular actions — each one giving some particular preparation in the governance until it stands upon its character.

The sixth rectification: Pekichu d'Ayinin — a rectification made in the eyes in which the Chasadim multiply — and they are open to influence always. And it comes also from N"H — from the aspect below the Yesod.

But the order of the Mazalos' descent is from the hidden Chochmah to the two Mazalos — as we shall write in the governance of the Chariot, with G-d's help.

יראה שאינם אלא אחת .כך בספירות — מי שמסתכל בעין שכלו ,יראה היותם קשורות בקשר אמיץ עס המאציל ב״ה ,ואינם נפרדות כלל ,והוא מתלבש בם .וזה ההתלבשות אינו כמו לבוש האדם ,שהוא דבר נפרד ממנו ,אלא כהדין קמצא דלבושיה מיניה .והמאציל משפיע לעולם בספירות ,וזולת זה לא היו יכולות להתקיים. ודע כי המאציל האציל כל המדריגות משונות זו מזו לקיום העולם, כי לפעמים צךיך העולם להתנהג בחסד או בדין או ברחמים .ועם כל זה ההשפעה בהן ממנו שוה ,אלא שמשתנה בתוך המדריגה כפי טבעה .וזה לך משל שני אנשים ,אחד חזק הטבע ואחד חלש ,שיאכלו מאכל שוה, לחזק יקיים טבעו ,ולחלש יקיים טבעו .ונמצא המאכל אחד ,והפעולות מתחלפות .כן הדבר הזה ,כי השפע מחזיק הספירות לפעול כפי מזגם. ונמצא השינוי בהם ,ולא בו. והספירות האלו יש מהם מתוקנות מעצמן ,וזה לקיום העולם .ויש שאינן מתוקנות אלא במעשה התחתונים ,וזה כדי שיקבלו שכר כשנתקנות על ידם ,ועונש כשנפגמות על ידם .והפגם הוא שתתאחז הס״א במדה ההיא ,ואינה מנחת אותה לעלות ולקבל השפע להשפיע למטה .כי על כן נקראת הס׳׳א — כובד אבן ,לפי שבהתאחזה במידות ־ ־ ?5בךת עליהן ,ואינם יכולות לעלות .שהמאציל רצה שתהיה זאת הס״א בעולם ,כדי שעל ידה יהיה עונש לרשעים .ולפנים בע״ה נפרש מה היא זאת הס״א ומהיכן יצאה.
segments.en:
The seventh rectification: Dumtza — rectified from the Malchus of Atik. And the secret of the two nostrils is the two aspects of Malchus in the secret of Leah and Rachel.

And know: all things created — all of them emerged from the Mazal and were clarified. Therefore all these kings were encompassed in this Dikna.88 And the place of their totality is in the first rectification of this Dikna — and they are called three worlds of the Dikna — for they are all encompassed88 in three: which are Bela, Yovav, Chusham. And these three are the root of all the created beings — both the created beings of holiness and the Sitra Achra89 — for the vessel must stand within its boundary and take its vitality as required by the governance.

התפשטות אורו ית׳ ע׳׳י אותיות

ודע כי סוד התפשטות האורות הוא סוד האותיות ,וצירוף האותיות הוא סוד הארת האורות העליונים הבונים המדריגות .והבן איך האותיות מורות התפשטות האור ,כי כמו שכל צורת האותיות אינו אלא נטיית הדיו לימין או לשמאל ,כן מורה על נטיית האור לימין או לשמאל או לאמצע .וכמו שהאותיות הם שחור על הלבן ,כן המדריגות הם אש שחורה על גבי אש לבנה .כי הלא מה שאנו אומרים — שהמאציל ית׳ צמצם אורו כדי לתת מקום לעולמות ,אינו ר׳׳ל שסילק אורו לגמרי ,ואינו מאיר בעולמות .כי זה אי אפשר אפילו לחשוב ,כי אם יצויר זה — העולמות לא היו יכולים להתקיים אפילו רגע אחד .אלא ר׳׳ל — שבמקום שעלה ברצונו הפשוט שיתפשטו המדריגות ,גנז אודו ,והחשיך אותו שלא יאיר כל כך בחוזק ,כדי שיתראה התפשטות התחתון ,דאם לא כן ,היה מתבטל ולא נראה ,כי שרגא בטיהרא מאי מהניא .וזהו אש

§12 — The Rectifications of the Hairs [Klalus HaIlan 8:4]

Av"A are covered under the Mazal — therefore we do not speak in detail of their aspects90 — for they are encompassed beneath it. Only what is common to all the Partzufim91 is certainly common to them as well.

aligned_segments.en: One who studies the books of our great master, the man of G-d, Rabbi Moshe Chaim Luzzatto z"tzal, and other books that engage with Chochmas HaEmes — finds before him, at the beginning of his study, many concepts that are new to him, each with many particulars. The difficulties that stand before him are not only in absorbing and understanding the new concepts in all their many particulars — but the main difficulty is to encompass the things and create from them a general picture and a complete structure.

aligned_segments.en: For it is only from seeing the overall structure — which is composed of the system of concepts of Chochmas HaEmes — that one can understand what this wisdom as a whole comes to teach us. (Certainly there are many teachings here, each deeper than the other.) Moreover — even each concept by itself can be properly understood only through grasping the overall picture. For only through discerning the place of each concept within this structure, and understanding its relations and connections with the other concepts — the other parts of the structure — can one arrive at the correct understanding of the concept.

aligned_segments.en: To what may this be compared? To a person who has never seen a clock and is unfamiliar with how it works. When shown the parts of a disassembled clock and told the nature of each part — the cogs, the screws, the hands, etc. — and when one tries to explain how all its parts work together, he still cannot grasp the nature and manner of working of the clock — as long as he has not seen a complete clock in operation. And he cannot correctly understand the nature and function of each part in this clock.

aligned_segments.en: It has happened that Torah scholars began to engage with Chochmas HaEmes — but because of this difficulty discontinued their study, since they had not yet received the overall picture from their engagement with the particulars of the wisdom. A burden of knowledge that is unordered and unclear — became heavy for them, and they had not the patience to persist in this study until they would see over time the fruit of their labour — a comprehensive, ordered structure in which each piece of knowledge would find its proper place.

aligned_segments.en: The overall picture of Chochmas HaEmes is called "the Sacred Tree." Just as a tree has roots and a trunk from which the branches emerge and upon which grow the leaves and the fruit — so too Chochmas HaEmes is arranged as a tree in all its parts. In order to know the nature, place, and function of the branches, leaves, and fruit — which are the particulars of the knowledge — one must first sketch the overall picture of the roots and trunk of this tree, which is the overall structure of Chochmas HaEmes. Rabbenu z"tzal sketched this tree for us in the ten chapters of "Klalus HaIlan HaKadosh" and expanded its explanation in the book "Pischay Chochmah VaDaas" — which is "the few that holds the many." But at the beginning we need a more general sketch of this tree — for the beginner: the particulars that Rabbenu included in this tree, even though they are foundational, conceal from his eyes the stature of the main trunk, and he still cannot encompass the overall structure of the tree of Chochmas HaEmes.

aligned_segments.en: A further difficulty for one who wishes to study Rabbenu's works engaging with Chochmas HaEmes: already at the beginning of his study he expects illuminating explanations of the content and meaning of Chochmas HaEmes — like one who studies Gemara and wants to enjoy and delight in the explanations of the great commentators before he has grasped the flow of the sugya and the simple meaning of the words. But the difficulty is even greater in Chochmas HaEmes — for it was transmitted to us in a system of concepts entirely new to us, and at the beginning of our study we have no foothold in it. This system was transmitted to us in the language of mashal;2 and Rabbenu calls it "the vision"3 — for so the prophets saw and envisioned it. The explanations of the nimshal — "the solution" in Rabbenu's terminology — can be well understood only when one knows the mashal thoroughly — its structure and the multiplicity of its concepts and particulars.

aligned_segments.en: We have seen prominent Torah scholars who began to study the book Klah Pischay Chochmah — which deals with the explanations of the nimshal, and contains also descriptions of the mashal — who saw at first a great light in the wondrous explanations of the nimshal. But in the course of their learning they came to realise that things were still not clear to them — for they did not know the overall structure of the mashal. Therefore they could not arrange and connect each piece of knowledge and explanation of the nimshal to that part of the mashal to which it relates. And they grew weary in this study. Indeed, of Chochmas HaEmes it is said with even greater force: "First review, and then reason deeply" [based on Avodah Zarah 19a] — as Rabbenu himself emphasises at the end of his essay "Derech Eitz HaChaim." First one must review the mashal deeply — and then one merits, with G-d's help, to understand the nimshal.

aligned_segments.en: His light, blessed be He,4 is infinite — without boundary or measure. It fills all, and relative to it no other existence is possible — "there is nothing other than it." At the very beginning of the creation of the world, Hashem contracted for our sake a part of His light, giving it boundary and measure — in order to allow existence to Creation and to the created beings, and so that we, the limited created beings, could attain something of His radiance. Tzimtzum (contraction) is from the language of covering — as the Sages of blessed memory used it: "and she covered her face" [Bereishis Rabbah end of ch. 45]5 — that is, Hashem covers Himself toward us, and reveals to us only limited revelations; but He Himself — no Tzimtzum or boundary applies to Him. The measure and degree of the Tzimtzum is such as to allow the possibility of the formation of darkness, matter, body, and evil — which create the possibility of serving Hashem through struggle and through choice between good and evil.

aligned_segments.en: The Sefiros are the revelation of His attributes, blessed be He — His ways and governances — to which the Creator gave measure, quantity, and number through the Tzimtzum. Therefore they are called Sefiros. Their name is also explained from the meaning of sapir — the sapphire stone that has no colour of its own, yet the rays of light sparkle within it in a variety of rainbow colours. So too the Sefiros — to us they are perceived as multi-coloured, in number and in measure — while His light, blessed be He, in and of itself admits of no division into colours, number, or limitation.

aligned_segments.en: His governances, blessed be He, divide into ten roots — ten Sefiros. They themselves divide into three groups of three Sefiros: Keser-Chochmah-Binah; Chesed-Din-Rachamim (also: Gedulah-Gevurah-Tiferes); Netzach-Hod-Yesod. And at the end of all of them: the tenth Sefirah — Malchus. In each group there are two Sefiros standing at the two extremities — right and left — and the third is intermediate between them. In each group the right Sefirah is in the aspect of Chesed — the influencer and giver. The left Sefirah is in the aspect of Din — the one that constricts; and relative to the right it has an aspect of receiver, limited according to its capacity for receiving. Between the two — the third Sefirah, intermediate between the two extremities. The three groups form a structure of three tiers of the attributes of His governance, with each tier having two Sefiros at the two extremities and a third intermediate Sefirah.

aligned_segments.en: The upper tier is arranged in the form of an inverted segol — Keser at the top with Chochmah and Binah beneath it. Keser stands at the head of the structure — for it encompasses the "purpose" of the entire structure — contained in the beginning of the thought, as the final purpose arises in His will in the aspect of "the end of the deed was first in thought." From it flow the remaining Sefiros, leading to the actualisation of the purpose of His governance. Since Keser encompasses the entire structure in the aspect of will and root — therefore its place is at the head of all the Sefiros, in the central column. Chochmah is the thought in broad strokes of how to carry out the will. Binah details and formulates these principles into detailed paths of execution.

aligned_segments.en: Sometimes Da'as is counted in place of Keser. According to this, the upper tier is arranged in the form of a segol: Chochmah — Da'as — Binah. Da'as appears in the middle, below Chochmah and Binah, for it flows from them. Da'as is the attribute of application of Chochmah and Binah — it transfers the conclusions of Chochmah and Binah to the remaining Sefiros, penetrating into them until it becomes their inner dimension.6 From the perspective of the relation of the ten Sefiros to the source — to the "world" or "Partzuf" above them — Keser is counted (as it is above the head of the King); while from the perspective of the influence of the head (= Chochmah and Binah) upon the Sefiros below them — Da'as is counted.

aligned_segments.en: The seven lower Sefiros constitute the structure of governance in actuality — the body of governance. They are mentioned in Scripture [Divray HaYamim I, 29:10]: "Yours, Hashem, is the greatness (=Chesed) and the might (=Din) and the splendour (=Rachamim) and the eternity and the majesty — for all that is in heaven and in earth (=Yesod) — Yours, Hashem, is the kingdom (=Malchus)." The principal attributes — their place is in the centre of the structure, in the second tier. They are arranged in a segol: Chesed and Din at the two sides, and below them in the middle: Rachamim (= Chesed-Din-Rachamim, or Chesed-Gevurah-Tiferes). These three Sefiros constitute the principal governance. Chesed is abundant and broad influence. Din constricts and limits the influence according to the deeds and merits of the receiver — and is also called Gevurah in the aspect of subduing and constricting ("Who is mighty? One who subdues his inclination"). Rachamim is the balanced equilibrium between these two extremities — and is also called Tiferes, for this is the governance in the splendour of its completeness, bringing Chesed and Din together in coordination and harmony. This attribute is also called Emes — Truth — for this is governance in the correct and precise balance, without veering right or left.

aligned_segments.en: The lower tier is formed by the Sefiros of the third grouping: Netzach-Hod-Yesod. They transmit and adapt for the created beings the governance of Chesed-Din-Rachamim7 — because as long as human beings have not completed the work of rectifying their deeds, the world cannot stand in the root attribute of Chesed — it cannot endure the abundance of goodness; nor can the world stand under the demands of the root attribute of Din — it cannot endure the abundance of adversity;8 nor has it yet arrived at the perfect equilibrium of the attribute of Tiferes. Therefore, so long as the world is not yet rectified, these Sefiros operate — in which the root Sefiros are blended. Sefirah of Netzach: Chesed with a blend of Din — from it flows the governance of "the righteous who suffers" — Hashem in His Chesed collects his debts in this world in order to grant him merit for the World to Come. Sefirah of Hod: Din with a blend of Chesed — from it flows the governance of "the wicked who prospers" — his merits are not lost through the force of Din but are paid to him in this world.9 Sefirah of Yesod — also called the attribute of "All" ("for all that is in heaven and earth") — it gathers all the actions of the entire wide spectrum of the attributes from end to end, in order to transmit all the abundance and influence to the lower beings who receive — to the tenth Sefirah: Malchus.

aligned_segments.en: Sefirah of Malchus ("Yours, Hashem, is the kingdom") is positioned below the Sefirah of Yesod, for it receives from it. It receives all the abundance in order to actualise through it, in Creation, the purpose of the governance of the nine Sefiros above it — the revelation of His kingship, blessed be He. And this needs to be done principally by the lower beings — by human beings. Therefore the Sefirah of Malchus is the root of created beings, and it oversees them and governs them according to the degree of their acceptance of His kingship. It is the aspect of the "Shechinah" that dwells within Yisrael — it is the bond between them and the Holy One Blessed be He.10

aligned_segments.en: To illustrate the ten Sefiros with a parable: the desire arises in a person to build a house for a certain purpose. In this desire everything of the house is already encompassed in the aspect of "the end of the deed was first in thought" — this is the aspect of Keser. The architect who plans the house with all its floors, wings, and rooms is in the aspect of Chochmah. The engineer who plans each and every detail — the types of materials and their quantities — is in the aspect of Binah. After them come the attributes of execution — in the above parable: the various craftsmen who do the framework, the plastering, the floors, etc. — this is the aspect of the six lower Sefiros: Chesed-Gevurah-Tiferes, Netzach-Hod-Yesod. The one who enters the house to dwell in it and make use of all that is in it, corresponding to the purpose of the structure — this is the aspect of Malchus, which receives the abundance from the nine Sefiros. The connection: Keser to Malchus — head with end — corresponds to the degree to which the execution matches the intention of the planner. The Sefirah of Da'as is like the function of the general contractor who gives instructions to the various craftsmen according to the plans of the architect and engineer, and stands over their proper execution.

aligned_segments.en: According to the above, the nine Sefiros of His governance, blessed be He, form three tiers vertically — one upon the other — the upper one being greater in kind and quality than the lower. On the other hand, they also form three groups horizontally — three columns: right, left, and centre. In the right column stand the Sefiros of Chochmah, Chesed, and Netzach — this is the column in the aspect of Chesed. In the left column stand the Sefiros of Binah, Gevurah, and Hod — this is the column in the aspect of Din. And in the central column stand the Sefiros of Keser, Tiferes, Yesod, and Malchus — they are in the aspect of the intermediate column between the extremities.

aligned_segments.en: The totality of all His governances, blessed be He, is called a world. His governances — reflected and operated on different planes in different modes — are the different worlds. For example: on the plane of the physical world — our world — all His governances operate in the ways of our world, the ways of matter. The Sefirah of Chesed is revealed in physical abundance and blessing, while the Sefirah of Din is revealed in the constriction of physical abundance — to the point of want and deficiency. In the spiritual world the same governances are expressed in a spiritual way — spiritual abundance or constriction of spirituality. But we must not think that there is only one spiritual world — as it might seem to us from our limited perspective. Rather there are many different spiritual worlds, one higher than another, more radiant and more pure. The higher a world — the purer and more spiritual the created beings in it. Principally the worlds divide into four: our world — the World of Asiyah (Action) (encompassing the material creatures and their spiritual roots — the appointed ministers over them); above it — the World of Yetzirah (Formation); above it — the World of Briyah (Creation); and above all of them — the World of Atzilus (Emanation) (= A"B"Y"A).11

aligned_segments.en: There is a great difference between the World of Atzilus and the worlds of B"Y"A — in that in B"Y"A there are spiritual and physical creatures (spiritual ones in the worlds of Briyah and Yetzirah and the beginning of the World of Asiyah). But in the World of Atzilus there are no creatures at all — in it is the totality of His lights, which reflect His governances. The creatures of the worlds of B"Y"A were created by the Creator as an existence separate from the Creator — as creatures that appear with their own independent being. Therefore they are called "the separated worlds." But the World of Atzilus, as stated, is a world of the modes of His governances — in it all His governances are in the aspect of His thought, revealing to us through His radiations — not yet at the stage of execution — of creatures. Therefore this world is called Atzilus — from the word etzel (beside, at) — still not separated from Him; and also from the word hatzel (emanation) — for from it the worlds of B"Y"A were emanated and created.12 This is a pure spiritual world from whose lights — in their orders and varieties — we learn all His ways, blessed be Him. The prophets envisioned through prophetic vision the brilliantly shining lights whose splendour was reflected in their souls — and they explained them to us in their prophecies — and they are explained in Chochmas HaEmes.13

aligned_segments.en: The general principle is: everything that is in one world repeats itself in the world below it — according to the nature of that world — and descends from the world above it. Everything from the World of Atzilus in terms of His ways, blessed be He, has a counterpart in the worlds of Briyah and Yetzirah — spiritual creatures that emerge from and execute His governances; and in the World of Asiyah — physical creatures that are also rooted in His governances (for example: parallel to the attribute of Din and the attribute of Rachamim in the World of Atzilus, there exist in the World of Yetzirah angels of Din and Rachamim, and in the World of Asiyah — physical creatures of Din and Rachamim, creatures that cause harm and creatures that bring abundance and blessing).

aligned_segments.en: Man is called a microcosm — for he encompasses within himself, in a miniaturised and concentrated form, all that is in the great world. Just as in every world all His governances, blessed be He, are reflected according to the aspect of that world — so too all His governances are reflected in the structure of man's soul,14 and also in the structure of his body (for example: because there exists the oversight of Hashem — "the eyes of Hashem" — man therefore has eyes; because in His governance there are two principal paths — Chesed and Din — which are the aspects of right and left — therefore most of man's limbs are doubled — to the right and to the left).15 This is what Scripture means when it says man was created in His likeness and image — and as is known, this refers to His governances — not to His essence, of which we have no apprehension whatsoever. His likeness and image — these are the structure of the totality of His governances — ten Sefiros branching and dividing into 613 particulars — after the fashion and measure of a human figure with his 613 limbs and sinews. But it is more accurate to say the reverse: that the figure of man with all his limbs and their functions corresponds to the form and image of His governances — for it descends and flows from them — as it is said that man was created in His likeness and image.16

שמכיל עיקר שרשי חכמת האמת
aligned_segments.en: One can perceive what is happening inside a person's soul through the expression of his face — that is, through his partzuf (face) one discerns the nature and character of the person. Therefore the structure of the Sefiros — arranged in the measure of human stature — is called a Partzuf — for it expresses all the inner dimension.

בעשרה פרקים בלשון המשנה

ומצורף לו ציור האילן הקדוש

מאת רבנו הגדול
aligned_segments.en: A complete governance is composed of ten Sefiros. But one of the Sefiros can itself be a complete governance according to its aspect and nature — and then that Sefirah subdivides into ten particular Sefiros, and from these is composed a Partzuf with 613 parts, in the measure of a human figure. For example: the Sefirah of Keser — when it encompasses all the Sefiros and governs them as the ultimate will that encompasses and directs all stages of planning and execution — it operates as a Partzuf (Arich Anpin) with its 613 limbs. And so too the Sefirah of Chochmah can operate as the encompasser and includer of all governance from the perspective of planning — from the vantage of Chochmah it oversees Chesed, Din, and the other attributes, planning them according to the reasons and rationale of wisdom. In this aspect of governance, Chochmah constitutes a Partzuf (the Partzuf of Abba) with all the limbs and particulars of the human figure. And so for the other Sefiros, as will be explained below.

aligned_segments.en: The higher Partzuf clothes itself through its lower part into the Partzuf below it. Through this it influences it and governs it. In the lower part of the Partzuf its lights diminish — therefore only it enters into the Partzuf below — for its lights that diminished there are adapted to the capacity of the lower Partzuf to receive them. Through the clothing, the action of the upper becomes revealed in the lower — just as clothing reveals something of the nature of the person who wears it. On the other hand, the clothed one is concealed and hidden by the garment — so the Partzuf that clothes itself is concealed within the Partzuf that clothes it — for the actions of the upper are not revealed directly, but only through the lower Partzuf — which is governed by the power of the upper Partzuf.

aligned_segments.en: Hashem contracted His light — which is without boundary or measure — and created within the infinite light the void: a limited place where there remained a contracted light within a boundary and measure, according to the need of creating the worlds. Around this limited place, the infinite light remains as it was — upon which the Tzimtzum and the boundary do not apply. The contracted light is called the Reshimu — for it is only like the remains and a small impression of the unlimited light. Into this Reshimu enters a line of light (kav) from the unlimited light that surrounds the limited place — in order to strengthen the light of the Reshimu and complete it.17 Thus, already at the very beginning of Creation, the two extremities of illumination and concealment were established — an illuminating line and a light-contraction: which are the roots of expansion and limitation, influence and contraction of influence, Chesed and Din, right and left, inner dimension and outer dimension, light and vessel, the influencing completor and the receiving deficient one needing completion, male and female, spirit and matter, soul and body, good and evil. All these matters create — through the combination of the two extremities — the possibility of creating the human being composed of body and soul, matter and spirit, giving him the possibility of choice between good and evil — between the dominance of the soul over the body or the reverse, G-d forbid. Naturally, the first stage of the contraction of the light and the illumination of the line — is only the first subtle root of all these matters that descend and flow from this root stage after stage. This is the purpose of the chain-descent and the fall — world after world, contraction after contraction: to prepare the possibility of service through choice for man in our world — the world of concealment and darkness, matter and body.

הקדמה לציור האילן הק׳
aligned_segments.en: The line illuminated within the Reshimu — and in combination with the Reshimu (for in all of Creation the actions of these two extremities are combined) — consolidated the first ten Sefiros in the form of circles. As the line entered the place of the Tzimtzum — at the beginning of its entry it formed the first circle within the round place of Tzimtzum: this is the Sefirah of Keser. As it continued to enter — it formed a circle again, creating within the circle of Keser the second circle: the Sefirah of Chochmah. And so it continued to enter, forming circles one within another: the Sefiros of Binah, Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferes, Netzach, Hod, Yesod — and in the centre: the circle of Malchus, the centre of all the circles — the execution of the intention of Creation: the revelation of His kingship, through which we merit the benefit — to enjoy the radiance of the Shechinah, the radiance of the glory of His kingship.

הקדמת לאיוי האילן
aligned_segments.en: The formation of circles one within another — one after another — indicates a relation of chain-descent between them. The outer circle that precedes and encompasses the inner circle is a cause to it: from within the Sefirah of Keser — which is the purpose aimed at in His will — flows and comes the Sefirah of Chochmah — the overall planning of the execution of the purpose; from it the Sefirah of Binah — the planning of the particulars; from it the Sefirah of Chesed — the execution of the purpose to influence Chesed upon the created beings; from it the Sefirah of Gevurah and Din — for in order for the Chesed to be complete, man receives the abundance according to his deeds — through Din — and not as an unearned gift. But the world cannot endure by the attribute of Din — therefore the attribute of Rachamim is required — Din blended with Chesed; and so on.

פרק ראשון
aligned_segments.en: These ten circles are the ten root Sefiros of the general Providence — which provides some existence to Creation and to nature in all periods and conditions of height and depth — as a constant framework within which man can do his service. Therefore the form of these Sefiros is circles — in which there is no right or left — merit or liability, above or below — ascent or descent. And so the first place of Tzimtzum is round — for the granting of possibility of place and existence through the concealment of His exclusive unlimited light — is equal for all of Creation.18

עד שלא נברא העולם הי ה הוא ושמו אחד .רצה וצמצם

א.
aligned_segments.en: The line creates within the Reshimu another order of ten Sefiros in the aspect of uprightness. The ten Sefiros of uprightness are arranged in three straight vertical columns (as explained above in the section "Sefiros"). Right column: Chochmah, Chesed, Netzach. Left column: Binah, Gevurah, Hod. Central column: Keser at the head between Chochmah and Binah; Tiferes between Chesed and Gevurah; Yesod between Netzach and Hod; and below all of them — Malchus. This arrangement is called "the human figure" — for the three uppermost Sefiros are in the aspect of the head: Keser is the skull encompassing the right and left brain — which are Chochmah and Binah. The seven lower Sefiros are in the aspect of the bodily limbs: Chesed and Gevurah — the two arms; Tiferes — the torso; Netzach and Hod — the two legs; Yesod and Malchus — the end of the body. "From my flesh I behold G-d" — from the structure of the body we learn of His governances — as explained above.

aligned_segments.en: The arrangement of the Sefiros of uprightness is the root of the individual governance and Providence — which governs man according to his deeds. Therefore it has right and left — a side of merit and a side of liability — above and below: ascent and descent. The two systems of Sefiros — circles and uprightness — operate together for the maintenance and advancement of the world. Therefore it is described that the Sefiros of uprightness are embedded within the Sefiros of the circles.19

It is called Adam Kadmon — for it is the primordial one relative to the figures of man in the other worlds, and it encompasses all His governances in a more elevated and concealed manner than the World of Atzilus.

aligned_segments.en: Adam Kadmon is the World of Reward — and relative to it — the World of Atzilus and the worlds below it: Briyah, Yetzirah, Asiyah — are the worlds of service. The World of Reward preceded in the order of creation the worlds of service — for the service was given for the sake of receiving the reward. And since the purpose of Creation is to benefit — to allow the creatures to enjoy the radiance of the Shechinah in ultimate pleasure — the World of Reward constitutes the root and source of all Creation in the aspect of "the end of the deed was first in thought." We are thus taught that Adam Kadmon encompasses all of Creation in the aspect of root — and all the worlds flow from it. It is the root and trunk of the Tree — and they are branches to it.

ד.
aligned_segments.en: In A"K we do not yet discern particulars as in the other worlds — and all that is said of it is only by way of analogy from what we understand from the lower orders. As stated, he himself is entirely beyond our apprehension — for the reward: "No eye has seen, O G-d, except You, what He will do for those who await Him" [Yeshayahu 64:3]. We speak only in allusion of the branches that emerge from him — what is revealed from the aspect of his senses: from the eyes, ears, nose, and mouth (the senses of sight, hearing, smell, and speech). Just as man's senses are openings to the outer world — so too the senses of Adam Kadmon are the openings through which the influence passes from his inner dimension to the worlds. (Man, however, absorbs impressions from outside through his senses — whereas A"K projects his abundance through them outward.) There are additionally greater radiations — flowing from the aspect of the skull of A"K: from his thought through his hairs — this is the revelation of the world of eternity, of which we have absolutely no apprehension.

Our Sages of blessed memory stated [Sanhedrin 97a]: "Six thousand years does the world exist and one is destroyed" — the years of service of the created beings are six thousand years. The seventh millennium is the passage from the World of Service to the World of Reward. After them and following them come the Worlds of Reward in the eighth and ninth millennia — from which one ascends to the World of Eternity — from the tenth millennium onward — in the aspect of the lights that emerge from the skull of A"K.

aligned_segments.en: From the ears emerge ten Sefiros, ten radiations — the World of Reward of the ninth millennium. From the nose emerge ten radiations — the World of Reward of the eighth millennium. From the mouth emerge ten radiations — the seventh millennium — of which it is said: "and one is destroyed" — in the aspect of "the ruin of the body is the building of the intellect" (in the words of the Rambam in his introduction to his commentary on the Mishnah) — the soul rules and the body still exists in some form, but ceases to operate. This is as stated the passage from the World of Service to the World of Reward. These lights that flow from his senses descend around him — reaching as far as the midpoint of the stature of A"K. Until here are the stages of the World of Reward.20

aligned_segments.en: From the midpoint of the stature of A"K downward begins the chain-descent of the World of Service. These are the ten Sefiros that emerged from the eyes21 of A"K — in the aspect of the eyes of Hashem that oversee in order to give each one according to his service. These lights that descended from the eyes are discernible only below the midpoint of the stature of A"K — for above him the great lights of ear-nose-mouth shine and dominate. Therefore it is only in the lower part of A"K that the first roots of the paths of service begin to take form. In the lights of the eyes are rooted the Worlds of Service: Atzilus, Briyah, Yetzirah, Asiyah.

פרק שלישי
aligned_segments.en: The principle is: the end of the higher level becomes the beginning and head of the lower level — for example: the Sefirah of Malchus of the higher world becomes Keser for the world below it and governs it. So too the Malchus of A"K becomes the head and Keser for the World of Atzilus. In order to clothe itself in the World of Atzilus and govern it, the Malchus of A"K is built into a Partzuf with all its particulars and parts — and is called "Atika Kadisha" (= A"K) or Atik. Atik is therefore the first Partzuf — (therefore called Atik: the ancient one) — in which we discern the human measure of stature with all its limbs and parts. (A"K is called man only by analogy — for we have no apprehension of its particulars.) Its seven lower Sefiros clothe themselves within the World of Atzilus. But its three upper Sefiros — Keser, Chochmah, Binah — which are the aspect of its head — are above the World of Atzilus, and we do not know their particulars; therefore they are called Reisha d'Lo Isyada — the Head That Is Not Known. In Reisha d'Lo Isyada are rooted the reasons of the World of Service — through them it is established what reward is due for this service and what reward for that; what portion in the general task of rectifying Creation each one receives — and according to this, what means (length of life, wisdom, livelihood, etc.) each one receives for carrying out his particular role. These principles of Providence are hidden from our understanding — and also are not needed for our service. Moreover, knowing them would interfere with our service — for it would diminish our freedom of choice if all were clear to us. Since Atik establishes each person's role — in that light it also establishes to what degree each fulfilled his role — and from this flows what reward is due him. Therefore Atik is what connects the World of Service to the World of Reward — the worlds of A"B"Y"A to A"K. Hence another meaning of atik — connector and transferer — in two directions: establishes according to the reward planned in advance (which is the goal) the fitting service as the means of attaining it; and on the other hand, transfers the results of the service to the corresponding reward due for it.

Five are the principal Partzufim — each being a complete governance according to the nature of the Sefirah from which the Partzuf is built, as explained above in the section "Sefirah — Partzuf — The Form of Man."

aligned_segments.en: The World of Atzilus is composed of the ten general Sefiros which constitute the structure of the totality of His governances, blessed be He. From them are built five Partzufim: from the Sefirah of Keser — the Partzuf of Arich Anpin; from the Sefiros of Chochmah and Binah — the Partzufim of Abba and Imma; from the Sefiros of Chesed-Gevurah-Tiferes-Netzach-Hod-Yesod — the Partzuf of Zair Anpin (explained in the chapter on Zair Anpin below — why from these six Sefiros one Partzuf alone is built); from the Sefirah of Malchus — the Partzuf of Nukva. There are additional Partzufim which are branches of the above Partzufim and secondary to them — explained in their places in Rabbenu's works. We shall explain the five principal Partzufim.

ז.
aligned_segments.en: The first and central Partzuf in the World of Atzilus is Arich Anpin (= A"A) — it is built from the general Sefirah of Keser of Atzilus (for the Partzuf of Atik belongs to A"K, which is above the World of Atzilus). The Sefirah of Keser encompasses the entire purpose — so too A"A brings Creation to its purpose and perfection. A"A is the central beam that runs from end to end — from the head of Atzilus to its end — spanning the entire measure of the height of Atzilus. As his name says: the long face — a long Partzuf. The other Partzufim are arranged around him, each clothing a part of him. In order to connect Atzilus to the Worlds of Reward, the seven lower Sefiros of Atik clothe themselves within A"A — as explained above. Arich Anpin brings the World of Service to its purpose — to the complete beneficence — when everything comes to its rectification; and he makes use of the other Partzufim that clothe him as means to bring everything to completion. Therefore A"A embraces the entire World of Atzilus. This governance is hidden and inner within the revealed governance of the other Partzufim — which clothe and cover A"A and he is concealed within them. His head is not clothed by the other Partzufim — for in it is the primary part of his governance, elevated above all other governances; from it comes the governance of unity that annuls when necessary the governance of judgment and influences goodness from a treasury of unearned gift even for the wicked — through the activation of the thirteen attributes of mercy.22

aligned_segments.en: Abba and Imma (= Av"A) are the Partzufim built from the general Sefiros of Chochmah and Binah of the World of Atzilus. They clothe the upper part of A"A — from the end of the head (for the head of A"A is not clothed) to his midpoint. They influence from the complete beneficence — which prevails mainly in the upper part of A"A (for in the lower part of every Partzuf his lights diminish) — to the Partzufim below them: Zair Anpin and Nukva (= Zu"N). In the aspect of father and mother they beget and raise Zu"N — who are their children. The first root of Zu"N is in A"A — for the governance of judgment executed by Zu"N has its root in the attribute of complete beneficence — in A"A — which wants to benefit creatures with complete benefit: that they should merit reward through their service and effort, not as an unearned gift accompanied by shame. In actuality the begetters are Av"A. They plan the paths of judgment and give the reasons for judgment — how each particular in it leads to complete beneficence.23 After Av"A have begotten Zu"N, they also guide them with wisdom and understanding — stage by stage — toward perfection. For the sake of the governance and completion of Zair Anpin, the Netzach-Hod-Yesod of Imma (within which the NHY of Abba is clothed) clothe themselves within the Partzuf of Z"A,24 as explained below.

aligned_segments.en: Zair Anpin (= Z"A) is the Partzuf of the governance of judgment — for it is built from the general Sefiros of the World of Atzilus: Chesed-Gevurah-Tiferes (= ChG"T) which are the three principal Sefiros of the governance of judgment. Also the Sefiros Netzach-Hod-Yesod (= NHY) of Atzilus participate in his structure — for they adapt the governances of Chesed-Din-Rachamim to the governance in actuality in this world (as explained above in the section "Sefiros"). Since Z"A is composed of six general Sefiros of Atzilus — ChG"T, NHY — he is also called the "six extremities" (= V"K). Each of these Sefiros does not constitute a Partzuf by itself — unlike Keser, Chochmah, and Binah — but all of them together constitute one Partzuf — for each one is only one part or side (one of the six extremities) of the governance of judgment. One of them alone cannot encompass a complete governance — only through the joint operation of these six Sefiros together is the governance of judgment composed.

Only in the future, when the redemption comes, will the governance of A"A be revealed to all eyes. This is the governance of unity — the absolute will of the Creator that brings everything — even evil — to rectification.

aligned_segments.en: The Partzuf of Z"A — built from the Sefiros of ChG"T, NHY — becomes a Partzuf with ten Sefiros when they subdivide into ten particular Sefiros, as every Partzuf has. But at the beginning only the six lower Sefiros from among his ten particular Sefiros operate in Z"A.25 This is his state of katnus (smallness). The three upper Sefiros — Chochmah-Binah-Da'as (ChB"D)26 — which are his Mochin (intellect), are not yet developed in him and do not yet operate. Through Av"A he arrives at gadlus (maturity) — through their influence his Mochin develop and grow. Just as father and mother raise their child and educate him until he becomes mature and capable of standing independently — so too Z"A perfects his Mochin through the NHY of Av"A clothing themselves within him. Through them Z"A receives his Mochin — so that he can operate with all ten of his Sefiros perfectly, with knowledge and understanding. The Sefirah of Keser — which is the skull encompassing the Mochin — Z"A receives through A"A. In His governances, blessed be He — the state of katnus is a state of concealment of face and exile — when the perfection of His governance is not recognised. While the state of gadlus is a state of revelation of face and redemption — when all recognise the wisdom and greatness of His governances. Also in the cycle of the seasons of the year there are states of katnus and gadlus — states of decrease and increase of spiritual abundance — in weekdays and in Shabbos and Festivals.

ד.
aligned_segments.en: The Partzuf of Nukva is built from the general Sefirah of Malchus of the World of Atzilus. She is the root of the receivers of His governance — of the created beings in general, and of all Yisrael in particular. She establishes the laws and paths of the receivers — toward which all the paths of influence are directed.27 She oversees the receiving created beings. Nukva receives the abundance from the male — from Z"A — and he, as stated, receives it from the Partzufim above him. She clothes Z"A from his midpoint downward — that is, from there she receives his influence. According to her preparation she unites with him and receives from him the abundance — in order to distribute it to the created beings. Her preparation for the union depends on the deeds of the lower beings — for through their evil deeds they blemish her, G-d forbid — until she is not fit to receive — and they cause a separation between her and Z"A. But through their good deeds they complete her — until she is fit to receive the full influence — and they bring her to cleaving with Z"A and cause her union with him: the union of the Holy One Blessed be He (the governance of influence — Z"A) with His Shechinah (— Nukva) — to receive the abundance for Yisrael who cleave to the Shechinah.

aligned_segments.en: Let us add an explanation: "union" (zivug) is a cooperation between two different forces — Sefiros or Partzufim. Through their joining — their union — a joint action emerges between them: a third power, Sefirah, Partzuf, or abundance. What is the nature of the union — the partnership — between Z"A and Nukva, between the giver and the receiver? For the giver is active while the receiver is only passive — so how is a cooperation between them possible — which is the matter of the union? We learn here a great principle in the service of the created beings — the receivers. His will, blessed be He, is to influence and to benefit the creatures; but the realisation of this will depends on the preparation of the receivers — on their merit and their refinement through their good deeds: to be fit to receive. The more the created beings complete themselves — the more the Holy One Blessed be He can influence; through this they fulfil more of His will — which is to benefit and to influence. Through this the created beings are truly partners in the bringing down of the abundance — this is the matter of their union with the Influencer. In the words of Rabbenu: "This is their merit — that they fulfilled the desire of the Emanator, blessed be He, Who desires that His existents receive His goodness."28

aligned_segments.en: In summary: A"K clothes itself through its Sefirah of Malchus into the World of Atzilus — for the Malchus of A"K becomes the Partzuf of Atik, and the seven lower Sefiros of Atik clothe themselves in the entire height of the Partzuf of A"A. A"A extends the entire length of the World of Atzilus — from its head to its end. The two Partzufim of Abba and Imma — which transfer the abundance of perfection from A"A to Z"A — clothe A"A from below his head to his midpoint — but the head of A"A is not clothed. Z"A clothes A"A from his midpoint downward — and Z"A himself is clothed from his midpoint downward by Nukva.

ח.
aligned_segments.en: The three principal Partzufim of the World of Atzilus are: A"A, Z"A, Nuk'. (Av"A are only the connectors between A"A and Zu"N — and they beget and complete them.) Arich Anpin — great of face, whose attribute is complete and perfect Chesed — brings the world through all the events of time to perfection and to the annulment of evil in the future. Zair Anpin is the governance of judgment that prevails in actuality as long as there is evil in Creation. Nukva is the root of the receivers of governance — the created beings — who according to their deeds she rises and falls — fitting to receive for them abundantly or sparingly. We are thus taught that the three principal Partzufim encompass the three fundamentals of Creation: the Purpose — perfection (A"A); the Action — the laws of Divine service (Z"A); the Actors — the creatures (Nuk' — who is their root). These three Partzufim — A"A, Z"A, and Nuk' — stand vertically: along the height of the World of Atzilus, one below the other. Z"A clothes A"A from his midpoint downward — and Nuk' clothes Z"A from his midpoint downward. The rule is: the higher the Partzuf (or the higher the world) — the more abundant is his Chesed. A"A in his essence is complete Chesed. On the other hand, Nukva is in the aspect of Din — for the receiver is limited and constricted in her capacity for receiving, according to what is due her through Din. Z"A — who influences Nuk' — relative to her is in the aspect of Chesed. But his measure of Chesed is small ("zeir") compared to the great Chesed of A"A ("arich"). Thus he is intermediate between A"A and Nuk' — in the aspect of Rachamim. According to this, one can also view the three Partzufim horizontally — in a row from right to left — in the aspect of Chesed-Din-Rachamim: A"A on the right, in the aspect of Chesed; Z"A in the centre, in the aspect of Rachamim; Nukva on the left, in the aspect of Din.29

aligned_segments.en: As stated above: the Sefirah of Malchus of a higher world becomes Keser for the world below it. Just as Atik (which is the Malchus of A"K) clothes itself in Atzilus — so too Nukva (which is the Malchus of Atzilus) clothes herself in the World of Briyah and becomes for it the aspect of Atik — and thereby connects the World of Briyah to the World of Atzilus. Similarly the Malchus of Briyah — its Nukva — becomes Atik for Yetzirah; and in the same way Yetzirah is connected with Asiyah. In the worlds of Briyah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah the same structure of the five Partzufim with their branches exists — but in each world the Sefiros and Partzufim operate according to the nature of that world, as explained above in the section "Worlds."

aligned_segments.en: The light that the vessel is capable of containing — this is its inner light. The remaining light that cannot enter the vessel — hovers over it from outside. This is the surrounding light, which illuminates the vessel from a distance; therefore its effect on the vessel is limited. The inner light operates in the vessel to refine and purify it, so that it can contain additional light. This is the reciprocal relationship between light and vessel: the vessel constricts the light; on the other hand, the light purifies the vessel and weakens its power of constriction. Then additional light from the surrounding light is able to enter the vessel and continue to purify and expand it — and prepare it for the entry of even more light; and so on. Light and vessel are the roots of soul and body — and their reciprocal relationship. The body impedes the entry of the light of the soul and limits its dominance. But on the other hand — the more the soul dominates the body and subjects it to the service of Hashem — the more it purifies it, and prepares it to receive within itself additional parts of the light of the soul that previously only hovered over it from above in the aspect of surrounding light.

ז׳ תיקוני רישא דא״א מז׳ תחתונות דעתיק:

aligned_segments.en: The description of the structure of the worlds and Partzufim above relates to the worlds in their rectified state — but preceding them were stages of breaking and destruction, and after them came stages of rectification. Our Sages of blessed memory said [Bereishis Rabbah 3:9]: "R' Avahu said: this teaches that He was creating worlds and destroying them, until He created these ones. He said — these please Me, those do not please Me." The destruction of the worlds — the Shevirah (Breaking) — and their re-creation — the World of Tikkun — is one of the central topics in Chochmas HaEmes, for this is the root of all possibility of rectification and corruption for man.

aligned_segments.en: A brief and fundamental preliminary principle of Chochmas HaEmes: "there is nothing new under the sun" — all possible descents and ascents were already prepared from the very beginning of Creation. Our Sages of blessed memory said [Bereishis Rabbah 3:10]: "R' Yanai said: from the beginning of the creation of the world the Holy One Blessed be He foresaw the deeds of the righteous and the deeds of the wicked. 'And the earth was chaos and void' — these are the deeds of the wicked; 'And G-d said let there be light' — these are the deeds of the righteous" — see there. Chochmas HaEmes teaches: how the Holy One Blessed be He prepared at the beginning of Creation — through foreseeing — the paths of rectification for the righteous, and the paths of corruption for the wicked.32 The stages of the destruction and rectification of the worlds and their re-building prepared the possibilities of descent and ascent for man.

aligned_segments.en: We shall describe the Shevirah and the Tikkun in broad strokes — without entering into the particulars of their causes and their detailed consequences. As mentioned above — ten Sefiros emerged from the eyes of A"K. First their ten vessels emerged, and then their ten lights emerged — which entered into the vessels. The three vessels of Keser, Chochmah, and Binah were able to receive the lights — for they were rectified, pure, and refined. But the seven lower vessels were not perfect — for various reasons there were in them impurities — unrefined parts — and therefore they could not receive their lights. When the lights entered into them — the vessels broke and fell from the World of Atzilus to the worlds of Briyah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah — but their lights remained in the World of Atzilus. This stage is called the World of Tohu — the world in a corrupted state. Afterward a new light emerged — ten Sefiros from the brow of A"K — in order to rectify the broken vessels. The broken vessels ascended and returned to the World of Atzilus, were rectified there, and their lights re-entered them. In combination with the ten Sefiros that emerged from the brow of A"K — from them all the Partzufim and Worlds were built. The building of the worlds after the Shevirah — which was discussed above — is the World of Tikkun.

פדק חמישי
aligned_segments.en: The impurities that were in the vessels — which caused their imperfection and their breaking — were separated and removed from the vessels through the Shevirah. When the vessels were re-created, the impurities did not serve as material for building the vessels — only from the finest parts were the Worlds of Tikkun and their Partzufim built. (The Shevirah and Tikkun were compared to a golden vessel with impurities — in order to purify it one breaks it and melts it in the smelting furnace; through this the impurities come out, and one pours it anew — complete and pure of impurities.) From these impurities — which remained after the rectification of the vessels — the structure of the Sitra Achra was built: it too is built in the form of four worlds with their Partzufim, for "this one corresponding to that one did G-d make" [Koheles 7:14]. But the place where the Sitra Achra stands is at the bottom of Asiyah. Through his evil deeds man strengthens its power and might, G-d forbid — until it can gain control in the worlds and Partzufim of holiness that parallel its own worlds and Partzufim — and again mix back into the vessels — causing a regression toward the Shevirah, G-d forbid. On the other hand — every good deed strengthens the light, and this subdues and diminishes the dominion of the Sitra Achra — which can spread only in the concealment of the light; and a little light pushes away much darkness. The complete clarification of the vessels from the admixture of impurities has not yet been completed in the creation of the World of Tikkun. There also remain within the impurities sparks of holiness — which descended with the vessels at the time of their breaking and falling — that need to be elevated through the use of the world's necessities for Divine service — and through this to bring them into the building of the World of Tikkun. Man's task is to complete and perfect the Tikkun of the world and to beware of corrupting it. Every commandment and every abstention from transgression are further steps toward the clarification and complete Tikkun — until evil is annulled from the world and everything arrives at its complete rectification with the help of the Creator of the world.
